# telnyx_dynamic_emergency_endpoint (Resource)

An endpoint for dynamic emergency calling, which links a callback number and caller name to a dynamic emergency address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_dynamic_emergency_endpoint" "example" {
  dynamic_emergency_address_id = telnyx_dynamic_emergency_address.example.id
  callback_number              = "+15125550100"
  caller_name                  = "Acme Austin office"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `callback_number` (String)
- `caller_name` (String)
- `dynamic_emergency_address_id` (String) An id of a currently active dynamic emergency location.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the resource was created
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `sip_from_id` (String)
- `status` (String) Status of dynamic emergency address
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the resource was last updated

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_dynamic_emergency_endpoint.example <id>
```
